Special characters appear as real characters; U+00A0 (no-break space) and U+200D (zero-width joiner) are written as \u00a0 / \u200d escapes so they are visible.

A value of {text, html} means the element contains markup (
, , ): "html" is the exact innerHTML to reproduce, "text" its text with each forced
written as "\n".

Asset URLs are given as live URLs (the snapshot mirrors them under /Users/kartikmiital/Downloads/assets/<host>/<path>). Video URLs are as mirrored by the saver (query string folded into the file name).

All elements on the page have alt="" (decorative). No element in has aria-label or title; the only ARIA attribute is aria-current="page" on the logo link, plus role="list"/"listitem" on the blog CMS lists.

"strings" is the flat per-section list compared by tools/text-diff.mjs (DOM order, whitespace collapsed,
= space). "hiddenAt" lists strings that are in the DOM but not rendered at that viewport (desktop 1440x900, tablet 991x900, mobile 390x844).

faq.heading: Questions and Answers

items.question: How long does it take to get started?
items.answer: Our turnaround is lightning-fast. Just one week from signing off and we’re there with the kick-off meeting to get it rolling.

items.question: What is your typical working process?
items.answer: It all starts with grabbing a cup of coffee, chilling with mates, and some quality time at the PlayStation (just kidding!). We always start a project with analysis, learning the requirements, and making estimates that will be shared in the price proposal. Then it’s off to signing off, kicking off, and getting your business to the next level with a pinch of our design magic.

items.question: Do you work on a fixed-price basis or time and material?
items.answer: Flexibility is the key of success in this crazy world, so we try to suggest an appropriate solution for each specific case we deal with. The more clear and detailed the requirements are, the more accurate will our estimates be. This is the closest we get to the fixed-price model.

items.question: How do you usually start new collaborations?

answer.text: Each new engagement starts with an introduction call and filling out the design/branding brief. If you have a cool project in mind, feel free to get in touch at hello@outcrowd.io
answer.html: Each new engagement starts with an introduction call and filling out the design/branding brief. If you have a cool project in mind, feel free to get in touch at hello@outcrowd.io

items.question: Do you guys work with big companies only? We’re an early-stage startup.

answer.text: We’re all for building a borderless world, so we are open to working with any project we come across. By the way, we do believe in startups, and one of those we helped develop from scratch has been sold to businesswire.com
answer.html: We’re all for building a borderless world, so we are open to working with any project we come across. By the way, we do believe in startups, and one of those we helped develop from scratch has been sold to businesswire.com

items.question: How long it will take to get an estimate from you?
items.answer: We hate to keep you waiting. Setting up a team, making preliminary research and analysis, and getting back to you with the contract will take up to 24 hours from the moment we learn what’s needed. Efficiency is one of Outcrowd’s key values.

items.question: Do you have a minimum engagement?
items.answer: We set no entry thresholds for people who want to work with us. But we still believe that a product that needs to be designed can’t be made within a couple of days. After all, we need some time to research, analyze and come up with a strategy. So we’ve set a minimum project duration as 30 hours and we’re waiting for you!

items.question: What’s the average project duration?
items.answer: Our team works full-time on every project, so the overall duration will highly depend on the initial estimate. On average, our projects last from 2 weeks to 5 months.

items.question: Can we start the design without wireframes?
items.answer: Wireframes help to build UX without distractions. The wireframe is an essential part of the design process and we would not recommend eliminating it. Having everything polished at the wireframing stage, we can avoid many amendments and revisions at the design stage, which saves both time and money.

items.question: What templates does Outcrowd use to create design?
items.answer: We don’t use pre-built templates or kits because there’s just no soul in them. We’re committed to building fully customized and product-based solutions that will meet the expectations of the target users. Each pixel and line is designed with love and passion by our creative minds.

items.question: Where should I start with my business if I have an idea?
items.answer: Hey, you’ve come to the right place! Please get in touch and we’ll help you with the ideation, design, and development. Full cycle on us, no hassle for you. Easy, right?
